explanation.text: The Logic: NIC stands for National Industry Classification system used in India for classifying business activities and industries. The Trap: NIC is specifically India's industry classification system, comparable to GICS globally and NAICS in the US. Note: NIC is one standard industry classification system in India, but analysts should still assess whether the classification captures the substance and economics of the industry.
